recipe.visualDefinition: A vintage-inspired album cover featuring a trio of men in a soft-focus, warm-toned photograph. The composition uses a triangular arrangement of subjects with a dominant, stylized display typeface in the upper right and a clean tracklist in the upper left.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm sepia-toned photography against a cream-colored background
Heavy, interlocking display type contrasting with thin sans-serif body text
Overlapping subjects creating depth through soft-focus layering
Text placement following the negative space created by the subjects' heads
coreInvariants: High-waisted, interlocking letterforms for the main title
Left-aligned vertical list for secondary information

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three men arranged in a pyramid; one in the foreground center, one to the right, and one slightly faded in the background top-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, black display type in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold title, moves down to the foreground faces, then sweeps left to the vertical tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample cream-colored space in the upper corners utilized for text placement.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep brown and black for typography and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm sepia and tan mid-tones in the skin and clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a compressed value range, avoiding pure whites or deep blacks in the image area.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight kerning with overlapping strokes
Heavy weight with minimal internal negative space
Baseline shifts to allow letters to nest into one another
characterSpecificRedesigns: O and E characters are often tucked under the arms of T or K
S has a tight, circular curl
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme weight contrast between a heavy, decorative display face and a light, functional sans-serif.

avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the rounded, thick geometric feel of the 70s display type.
Matches the clean, geometric secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus, grainy photograph of three men in 1970s attire (collared shirts, vests, glasses). The men are arranged in a triangular group portrait. The color palette is warm sepia and cream. The background is a plain, light-colored wall with soft shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, ultra-bold, interlocking geometric sans-serif title in the upper right corner in black. Add a vertical list of text in a small, light sans-serif font in the upper left corner in dark brown.

verificationChecks: Is the main title text overlapping and tightly packed?
Is the overall image tone warm and desaturated?
Are the subjects arranged in a clear hierarchy from foreground to background?
Is the film grain visible but not distracting?

adjustableVariables: Amount of overlap in the display typography
Depth of field/blur on the background subjects
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Exact wording of the tracklist and titles
Any specific brand logos or signatures

mustAchieve: Legible but highly stylized display type
Balanced distribution of text in negative space

postGenerationChecks: Check for interlocking letterforms in the display title.
Ensure the color palette remains strictly within warm tans and creams.
Verify that the secondary text is light and clean for contrast.
Confirm the photographic style has a soft, analog feel.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [warm-toned group portrait] with [interlocking 70s display type] and [minimalist sans-serif lists] to create a [vintage folk-pop aesthetic].
